title: Minecraft Creeper Explosion
blurb: The hiss is the important part. By the time the blast lands, your house has a hole in it and the diamonds you were carrying are somewhere at the bottom of a lava pool. Creepers exist because of a modelling accident — Notch got the dimensions wrong while building a pig and shipped the result as a monster instead. That mistake became the face of the entire game. Reach for this clip when something has been quietly building behind somebody and is about to delete all their progress at once.
origin: The creeper hiss and explosion from Minecraft.
